translated_title: Hyundai Accused of Leaving Transport Operators Without Routes and Putting More Than 300 Jobs at Risk

meta_description: The SITRABICS union says the automaker is faking a bankruptcy to dodge a T-MEC labor order and pushing drivers into cabotage that costs them their US visas.
